description.value: Shipyards Coffee is an independent coffee bar tucked into the Shipyards District at Lonsdale Quay in North Vancouver, proudly serving the waterfront community for over 15 years. The café offers a full espresso bar, freshly baked croissants and pastries, smoothies, and a rotating selection of specialty single-origin and blended coffee beans. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a welcoming stop along the North Shore waterfront cycling corridor.

address.value: 123 Carrie Cates Ct #156, North Vancouver, BC V7M 3K7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record on name, address, and phone. The café advertises 15+ years of operation at Lonsdale Quay with indoor and outdoor seating (matching OSM indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=yes), an active espresso and food menu, and an online shop, confirming it is a legitimate, operating business. No bike racks, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields remain null; gluten-free and plant-based milk options are explicitly named on the menu, supporting a true for that amenity.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established café at a landmark waterfront cycling destination on the North Shore; touring cyclists would benefit from food, specialty coffee, and outdoor seating at Lonsdale Quay.
